sources.title: [2502.05223] KDA: A Knowledge-Distilled Attacker for Generating Diverse ...
sources.snippet: To address this challenge, we propose to distill the knowledge of an ensemble of SOTA attackers into a single open-source model, called Knowledge-Distilled Attacker (KDA), which is finetuned to automatically generate coherent and diverse attack prompts without the need for meticulous system prompt engineering.
